all_92_gates.contract: validity_rate >= 0.99 AND full 94,208-row package AND terminal PASS_RICH_ASV2_HISTORICAL_VOTES_FROZEN_READY_FOR_SCORING
all_92_gates.positive_signal: relative improvement TRUE vs C0 >= 0.01 in at least one year

bootstrap.role: diagnostic; frozen point-estimate gates remain decisive

constraints: 2016 context remains weakly discriminative and must be flagged
no threshold/prompt/model/population/condition mapping changes after real outputs are inspected
R2/no-attitude ablation may be run only after the primary R3 verdict and cannot rescue a failed primary verdict

direct_58_robustness_gates.negative_control_both_years: TRUE RMSE <= SHUFFLED RMSE in both years on the direct subset
direct_58_robustness_gates.not_materially_worse_both_years: TRUE RMSE <= 1.01*C0 RMSE in 2016 and 2021 on the identical 58-territory direct-microdata subset
direct_58_robustness_gates.positive_signal_not_proxy_confined: for at least one year where ALL_92 relative improvement >=1%, TRUE relative improvement on DIRECT_58 must be >=0

primary_metric: macro_party_share_RMSE over 92x9 cells per year; lower is better
